issue.title: The translation is incorrect.
issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] I checked the documentation and found no answer; - [x] I checked to make sure that this issue has not already been filed; - [x] This is not an ad/bug report. ### Problem description In the Japanese version of AdGuard for Android, 'Apps' is translated as 'VPN対象外アプリ,' which means 'apps excluded from VPN.' ### Proposed solution "Apps" should simply be translated as "アプリ" (or "アプリ別" to convey "by app"). The current translation "VPN対象外アプリ" is incorrect — it actually means "apps excluded from VPN," which is a completely different meaning and has nothing to do with this section, which just shows a per-app breakdown of blocked ads/trackers. ### Additional information I think everything went smoothly up to 4.1.2.3.

issue.title: The translation is incorrect.
issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] I checked the documentation and found no answer; - [x] I checked to make sure that this issue has not already been filed; - [x] This is not an ad/bug report. ### Problem description In the Japanese version of AdGuard for Android, 'Apps' is translated as 'VPN対象外アプリ,' which means 'apps excluded from VPN.' ### Proposed solution "Apps" should simply be translated as "アプリ" (or "アプリ別" to convey "by app"). The current translation "VPN対象外アプリ" is incorrect — it actually means "apps excluded from VPN," which is a completely different meaning and has nothing to do with this section, which just shows a per-app breakdown of blocked ads/trackers. ### Additional information I think everything went smoothly up to 4.1.2.3.

## Prerequisites

- [x] This is not an ad/bug report;

- [x] My changes do not break web sites, apps and files structure.

## What problem does the pull request fix?

- [x] Website or app doesn't work properly;

## What issue is being fixed?

- Fix https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/237122
- Fix all other websites and apps that will use [Intech Solutions Pty Ltd](https://www.intechsolutions.com.au/), which are Address Validation Software based in Australia, which include Australian and New Zealand Government websites.

> Australian Government 2026 Census is unable to be used due to address validation being blocked due to "Protect against DPI" being enabled for stealth mode. Unchecking "Protect against DPI" and refreshing the page allows the address list to load.

I'd be comfortable whitelisting the entire domain instead of `iaws-cds.intechia.com/rest/address/search` as they use other validation services that may use other URL types within this domain.

### Terms

- [x] By submitting this issue, I agree that pull request does not contain private info and all conditions are met

## What problem does the pull request fix?

## What issue is being fixed?

- Fix https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/237122
- Fix all other websites and apps that will use [Intech Solutions Pty Ltd](https://www.intechsolutions.com.au/), which are Address Validation Software based in Australia, which include Australian and New Zealand Government websites.

> Australian Government 2026 Census is unable to be used due to address validation being blocked due to "Protect against DPI" being enabled for stealth mode. Unchecking "Protect against DPI" and refreshing the page allows the address list to load.

I'd be comfortable whitelisting the entire domain instead of `iaws-cds.intechia.com/rest/address/search` as they use other validation services that may use other URL types within this domain.

### Terms

- [x] By submitting this issue, I agree that pull request does not contain private info and all conditions are met

issue.body:
## Prerequisites

- [x] This is not an ad/bug report;
- [x] My code follows the [guidelines](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [syntax](https://kb.adguard.com/general/how-to-create-your-own-ad-filters) of this project;
- [x] I have performed a self-review of my own changes;
- [x] My changes do not break web sites, apps and files structure.

## What problem does the pull request fix?

- [x] Website or app doesn't work properly;

## What issue is being fixed?

- Fix https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/237122
- Fix all other websites and apps that will use [Intech Solutions Pty Ltd](https://www.intechsolutions.com.au/), which are Address Validation Software based in Australia, which include Australian and New Zealand Government websites.

> Australian Government 2026 Census is unable to be used due to address validation being blocked due to "Protect against DPI" being enabled for stealth mode. Unchecking "Protect against DPI" and refreshing the page allows the address list to load.

I'd be comfortable whitelisting the entire domain instead of `iaws-cds.intechia.com/rest/address/search` as they use other validation services that may use other URL types within this domain.

### Terms

- [x] By submitting this issue, I agree that pull request does not contain private info and all conditions are met

issue.title: The translation is incorrect.
issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] I checked the documentation and found no answer; - [x] I checked to make sure that this issue has not already been filed; - [x] This is not an ad/bug report. ### Problem description In the Japanese version of AdGuard for Android, 'Apps' is translated as 'VPN対象外アプリ,' which means 'apps excluded from VPN.' ### Proposed solution "Apps" should simply be translated as "アプリ" (or "アプリ別" to convey "by app"). The current translation "VPN対象外アプリ" is incorrect — it actually means "apps excluded from VPN," which is a completely different meaning and has nothing to do with this section, which just shows a per-app breakdown of blocked ads/trackers. ### Additional information I think everything went smoothly up to 4.1.2.3.

comment.body: @cnt-r thank you for the report, translation is fixed, it will be reflected in the app in the next updates.

## Prerequisites

- [x] This is not an ad/bug report;
- [x] My code follows the [guidelines](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [syntax](https://kb.adguard.com/general/how-to-create-your-own-ad-filters) of this project;
- [x] I have performed a self-review of my own changes;
- [x] My changes do not break web sites, apps and files structure.

## What problem does the pull request fix?

- [x] Website or app doesn't work properly;

## What issue is being fixed?

- Fix https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/237122
- Fix all other websites and apps that will use [Intech Solutions Pty Ltd](https://www.intechsolutions.com.au/), which are Address Validation Software based in Australia, which include Australian and New Zealand Government websites.

> Australian Government 2026 Census is unable to be used due to address validation being blocked due to "Protect against DPI" being enabled for stealth mode. Unchecking "Protect against DPI" and refreshing the page allows the address list to load.

I'd be comfortable whitelisting the entire domain instead of `iaws-cds.intechia.com/rest/address/search` as they use other validation services that may use other URL types within this domain.

### Terms

- [x] By submitting this issue, I agree that pull request does not contain private info and all conditions are met

issue.title: The translation is incorrect.
issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] I checked the documentation and found no answer; - [x] I checked to make sure that this issue has not already been filed; - [x] This is not an ad/bug report. ### Problem description In the Japanese version of AdGuard for Android, 'Apps' is translated as 'VPN対象外アプリ,' which means 'apps excluded from VPN.' ### Proposed solution "Apps" should simply be translated as "アプリ" (or "アプリ別" to convey "by app"). The current translation "VPN対象外アプリ" is incorrect — it actually means "apps excluded from VPN," which is a completely different meaning and has nothing to do with this section, which just shows a per-app breakdown of blocked ads/trackers. ### Additional information I think everything went smoothly up to 4.1.2.3.

comment.body:
I ran into one movie that contains `files2`, so I had to add `\d?` to files as well.

`https://kimoitv.com/download/756283/4-Kings-2-2023-Full-720p.html`

> @@/\/cdn\/(files|zone\d?)\//$media,third-party,match-case,stealth=referrer,domain=kimoitv.com

It also needs to include `document` to fix downloads.
I had considered `/cdn/*`, but I thought that might be a little too wide.

> I changed it to a regex as some of them did not have /files/.

That's why I added another exception. I guess we can use this regex as I see only `files` or `zone1` there
```adblock
@@/\/cdn\/(files|zone\d?)\//$media,third-party,match-case,stealth=referrer,domain=kimoitv.com
```
or this one.
```adblock
@@/cdn/*$media,third-party,stealth=referrer,domain=kimoitv.com
```

comment.body: Ещё повторите проблему с открытым журналом фильтрации и инструментами разработчика (F12). При этом будут логироваться косметические и JS правила как на скрине Скопировав в журнал выведенные там правила (например #%#) можно сделать разблокиующими, добавим `@` в разделитель. Например для `#%#//scriptlet('set-constant', 'navigator.privateAttribution', 'undefined')` разблокирующее правило `#@%#//scriptlet('set-constant', 'navigator.privateAttribution', 'undefined')`

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://myshows.me/profile/#released](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmyshows.me%2Fprofile%2F%23released) ### Comment > продолжение https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/234354 > myshows.me #234354 > > зареган на сайте. > захожу по ссылке https://myshows.me/profile/ , сайт переходит на https://myshows.me/profile/#released, страница загружается, показывает ошибку "что-то пошло не так" и начинает бешено и бесконечно перезагружаться раз в секунду, регулярно показывая ошибку "что-то пошло не так". После временного отключения adguard и загрузки рекламы сайт некоторое время загружается и работает нормально (может быть, до устаревания рекламы в каком-то кэше?), а потом (допустим, через день) всё начинается опять. > Ссылка на видео https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cQxcuOKvwdKlNMUUmmscrzbrLQV978vw/view?usp=sharing > ====================== > can you check which module or a filter causes the problem? > > Yes, I checked - it turned out that it was the "ad blocker" module, a cookie notification filter - after disabling this filter, the endless rebooting ends, you can use the site for a few days, then something becomes outdated (probably) and the crazy rebooting starts again > > ``` Username: @evil-raider ``` ### Screenshots

comment.body:
> [@evil-raider](https://github.com/evil-raider) У меня не повторяется с вашими настройками. Можете проверить, какой модуль программы вызывает проблему? В настройках их можно выключать по отдельности.

переведу уже написанный ответ на этот вопрос

> Можете проверить, какой модуль или фильтр вызывает проблему?
> 
> Да, я проверил — оказалось, это был модуль «блокировщик рекламы», фильтр уведомлений о cookie-файлах. После отключения этого фильтра бесконечные перезагрузки прекращаются, сайтом можно пользоваться несколько дней, потом что-то устаревает (вероятно), и безумные перезагрузки начинаются снова.

уточню:
После отключения этого фильтра (и включения после успешной загрузки страницы) бесконечные перезагрузки прекращаются, , сайтом можно пользоваться несколько дней, потом что-то устаревает (вероятно), и безумные перезагрузки начинаются снова.

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://myshows.me/profile/#released](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmyshows.me%2Fprofile%2F%23released) ### Comment > продолжение https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/234354 > myshows.me #234354 > > зареган на сайте. > захожу по ссылке https://myshows.me/profile/ , сайт переходит на https://myshows.me/profile/#released, страница загружается, показывает ошибку "что-то пошло не так" и начинает бешено и бесконечно перезагружаться раз в секунду, регулярно показывая ошибку "что-то пошло не так". После временного отключения adguard и загрузки рекламы сайт некоторое время загружается и работает нормально (может быть, до устаревания рекламы в каком-то кэше?), а потом (допустим, через день) всё начинается опять. > Ссылка на видео https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cQxcuOKvwdKlNMUUmmscrzbrLQV978vw/view?usp=sharing > ====================== > can you check which module or a filter causes the problem? > > Yes, I checked - it turned out that it was the "ad blocker" module, a cookie notification filter - after disabling this filter, the endless rebooting ends, you can use the site for a few days, then something becomes outdated (probably) and the crazy rebooting starts again > > ``` Username: @evil-raider ``` ### Screenshots

comment.body:
> Ещё повторите проблему с открытым журналом фильтрации и инструментами разработчика (F12).
> При этом будут логироваться косметические и JS правила как на скрине

с таким фильтром в консоли ничего не было.

Эта информация, а также записи в консоли без фильтра (много всяких ошибок 500) привели меня к мысли о том, что это не совсем проблема adguard, а еще и проблема раздельного туннелирования множества ресурсов с одного сайта (видимо, какие-то ресурсы загружались с одного IP, а какие-то с другого, и видимо, это не нравилось сайту вместе с adguard). После исправления этой проблемы сайт повторяемо стал загружаться без изменений в adguard. Каким образом одно влияло на другое - мне непонятно, но у меня проблемы на данный момент нет, вряд ли вы захотите делать что-то сверх этого. 
Issue можно закрывать. Благодарю за попытку устранения проблемы.
